localization.description:
Discover salons, find beauty inspiration and keep your salon work connected with Reylumi.

EXPLORE BEAUTY NEAR YOU
Browse salon profiles, services and published work. Find ideas for your next visit and request an appointment when online booking is available.

SHARE YOUR STYLE
Create a beauty profile, share your work and join conversations. Report inappropriate content, block users and manage your account privacy in Settings.

TOOLS FOR SALONS AND TEAMS
Use your salon workspace to manage appointments, services, staff access and customer activity. Available tools depend on your role and the features your salon enables.

OPTIONAL MARKET FEATURES
Salon owners can add optional Market features. Some features require a paid subscription. Availability and pricing are shown before purchase.

Browse public content without an account. Sign in to use personal and salon workspace features. Account deletion is available in the app.
